stem: Why should material from different harvest dates remain traceable through drying and storage?
choices: Separate identity preserves the ability to connect conditions, test results and deviations to the correct lot
Dates no longer matter after cutting
rationale: Post-harvest records need lot identity so product history and quality decisions remain auditable.
